Bash(gh pr create --title "feat: Add Cut Optimizer API with PDF generation" --body "$(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary

This PR adds a complete Rust-based Cut Optimizer API for 2D bin packing optimization with PDF layout diagram generation.

### Core Features
- **FFDH Algorithm**: First-Fit Decreasing Height algorithm for efficient piece placement
- **Guillotine Cuts**: Supports standard panel saw constraints
- **Edge Banding**: Tracks and visualizes edge banding requirements
- **PDF Generation**: Creates professional layout diagrams with printpdf

### API Endpoints
- `POST /api/v1/validate` - Validate optimization requests
- `POST /api/v1/optimize/quick` - Synchronous optimization with optional PDF
- `GET /api/v1/templates` - Get predefined stock sheet templates
- `GET /health` - Health check endpoint

### PDF Layout Features
- A4 portrait format with header, sidebar, and diagram regions
- Material info, job reference, client name, and statistics in header
- Cutting list sidebar with aggregated piece counts
- Scaled sheet diagram with piece IDs and dimensions
- Edge banding visualized as red dashed lines

### Technical Stack
- **Framework**: Actix-web 4.x
- **PDF**: printpdf 0.7
- **Serialization**: serde/serde_json
- **Logging**: tracing/tracing-subscriber

### Testing
- 32 tests total (24 unit + 8 integration)
- Tests cover validation, optimization, edge banding, PDF generation

## Test plan
- [x] Run `cargo test` - all 32 tests pass
- [x] Run `cargo check` - compiles with warnings only
- [ ] Manual test: POST to `/api/v1/optimize/quick` with `generate_pdf: true`
- [ ] Visual inspection: Decode base64 PDF and verify layout

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
)")
